This [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] '''officer''' served with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During a [[Battle of Cavamina Minor|battle]] near the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Cavamina Minor]], Mundi's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] faced a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]]. The war profiteer [[Attuma Duum]] lured the two fleets to his [[Attuma Duum's headquarters|asteroid base]] to ambush them with a [[Space mine/Legends|mine field]] in hopes of prolonging the war. In the midst of the battle, this [[Officer/Legends|officer]] informed General Mundi that the Republic [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Vagabond (starship)|''Vagabond'']] had been lost. General Mundi recalled the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and his fleet left the battle.

This officer wore the uniform of the Republic Navy; he wore his brown hair cropped short and appeared to have a thin moustache.

==Behind the scenes==
This unnamed officer appears in a single frame in the graphic novella ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''.
